evidence.quote: This year our WASTX Plastic was nominated in the category INNOVATION as one of the TOP6 most promising technologies.

Together with Plastoil, our distributor for Australia and New Zealand, we have reached the next milestone – the commissioning of our first WASTX Plastic as well as the first pyrolysis plant in Australia.
After over 10 years of development and great effort, the Green Refinery technology has been successfully producing a completely vegan and organic fertilizer – Blattwerk Pure.
Im vergangenen Jahr haben wir mit der Biofabrik Systems unseren Service für individuelle Entwicklung und Beratung gestartet.
Neben individuellen Projekten arbeiten sie an einem externen Standort an der Weiterentwicklung der WASTX Plastic.
